races.title: DBS And Willmott Dixon Building Together Handicap Chase
races.verdict: It's difficult to get away from GOLLY GOSH , who has taken well to chasing for his new yard and the front-running tactics that were successfully adopted last time often work well around here. Jac Jumper is potentially well handicapped on his best form, so he could emerge as the main threat if ready to go after a lengthy lay-off, with Largy Panic rounding off the shortlist. GOLLY GOSH (IRE) JAC JUMPER (FR) LARGY PANIC (IRE)

races.title: JDA Grand Design Mares' Handicap Chase
races.verdict: This looks a good chance for GATA BAN to land a third success of the season. With doubts about Out On Her Own 's stamina over 3m it could be that the class-dropping Princess Keri , who shaped better than the result on her reappearance, gives Neil Mulholland's charge most to do. GATA BAN (IRE) PRINCESS KERI (IRE) OUT ON HER OWN

races.title: Lexy 21st Birthday Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A good-looking bumper with the pedigrees and yards on show. HELIOS FORLONGE was bought for a handsome sum after finding only one too good on his only outing in Irish points, so makes obvious appeal on this switch to Rules having joined a quality outfit. Francisco Alvares merits attention for a stable going well with its bumper horses, while Mirage D'alene is another to note. HELIOS FORLONGE (FR) FRANCISCO ALVARES MIRAGE D'ALENE (FR)
